core.subtitle: Core workflow
core.title: How does the Douyin account analyzer work?
core.description: MediaClaw connects creator discovery, public video collection, sample confirmation, transcript enrichment, and report generation instead of stopping at profile totals.

items.title: 1. Find benchmark Douyin creators through strong videos
items.description: Search an industry, product, or content term, then combine time and engagement filters to surface recent strong videos. Recurring creators and low-follower/high-engagement signals help narrow the shortlist before manual review.

image.alt: Douyin search results filtered by time and likes to find high-performing videos and benchmark creators

items.title: 2. Collect public profile videos and start account analysis
items.description: Open a target Douyin profile, set the loading limit, like threshold, and topic filter, then collect at least 50 public videos. Profile fields, publish dates, engagement, and video links become a reviewable account sample.

image.alt: MediaClaw collection filters for public videos on a Douyin creator profile

items.title: 3. Stratify the video sample, with manual control
items.description: The system selects high-engagement, representative, and low-engagement comparison videos. Review and adjust the sample before analysis so ads, off-topic posts, or one-off hits do not distort the findings.

boundaries.subtitle: Data boundaries
boundaries.title: What are the data boundaries for Douyin creator analysis?
boundaries.description: The goal is better video research with public, traceable evidence—not access to private data or unsupported conclusions about a creator.

items.title: Public pages only
items.description: The workflow does not provide private accounts, creator dashboards, contact details, or information the platform does not make public.

items.title: Separate facts from inference
items.description: Profile fields and engagement counts are evidence. Positioning, audience, and video patterns are conclusions that should be tested across more samples.

items.title: Use data responsibly
items.description: Use collected information only for authorized research, operations, and content review while following platform rules and applicable laws.

items.question: What is the difference between Douyin profile scraping and account analysis?
items.answer: Profile scraping organizes public account fields and historical videos into a usable sample. Account analysis compares positioning, topics, openings, voice, visuals, and engagement differences. Collection prepares the evidence; analysis turns it into content conclusions.

items.question: How do I find the right benchmark Douyin accounts?
items.answer: Start with niche terms and content themes close to your business. Combine publish-time and engagement filters to find recent strong videos, then review recurring creators, low-follower/high-engagement accounts, and creators at a comparable stage.

items.question: How many videos do I need for a Douyin account analysis?
items.answer: Start by collecting at least 50 public videos from the target profile. The system selects high-engagement, representative, and low-engagement comparison samples, and you can adjust the selection before analysis.

items.question: Do I need to extract every transcript first?
items.answer: No. After account analysis starts, the workflow enriches selected representative videos with the details and transcripts needed for comparison. Use the separate transcript tool when you only need a small set of specified videos.

items.question: Can an account be analyzed if its videos have no spoken narration?
items.answer: Public titles, topics, visual format, duration, and engagement can still provide evidence, but voice and script conclusions will be limited by the available text. The report should keep observed facts separate from hypotheses.

items.question: How long does a full Douyin account analysis take?
items.answer: A first complete analysis typically takes about 10-20 minutes, depending on sample size and how much public video evidence needs enrichment. The task can continue in the background while the progress panel shows the current step.

items.question: Can this reveal private audience demographics?
items.answer: No. This page does not provide creator-dashboard demographics. Public profiles, video themes, and comments can suggest audience signals, but those are research inferences—not exact audience statistics.

items.question: What should I do after finishing an account analysis?
items.answer: Add priority creators to monitoring, preserve representative videos and transcripts in your research library, and validate demand through comments and keywords. This turns a report into an ongoing video idea, script, and review workflow.
